features: Extend sprite sheets with click-to-isolate imports in the standalone editor.
Create, clear and export sprite sheets losslessly with touch pan, zoom and resizable panes.
Extract all sprites, preview isolation masks, remove placements and compact sheets.
Anchor, scale and shrink imported sprites within reserved tiles.
bugfixes: Fix standalone sprite sheet editor builds for supported browsers.
Keep sprite sheet information visible above the editor canvas.
Allow source sprites to be imported again after switching target sheets.
Fix source canvas clicks when importing sprites in the sheet editor.
